toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Herhaal' is transitive in Afrikaans; intransitive 'strepe wat herhaal' is an anglicism, and the lesson's own pattern definition says 'herhaal word'.
toegepas.fout: Intransitive 'herhaal' copies English 'repeats'; Afrikaans needs 'herhaal word' (or a reflexive).
toegepas.rede_keurder: Fixes the anglicism without moving the meaning and matches the lesson's own pattern wording.

toegepas.fout: Comma before 'of' where the second part has no subject and verb of its own, against the AWS 2017.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Removing the comma follows the AWS rule and the sentence stays clear.

toegepas.na: wanneer hulle in 'n patroon langs mekaar lê

toegepas.fout: Singular 'dit' sits awkwardly with reciprocal 'langs mekaar'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Hulle' agrees with the two colours lying next to each other; same meaning, smoother.

toegepas.blok: Jou eie werk en jou omgewing
toegepas.na: Pas hierdie stappe ook toe op
toegepas.rede_vinder: Steps are applied ('toepas op') to work; 'gebruik op' is an anglicism.
toegepas.fout: 'Gebruik ... op' copies English 'use on'; Afrikaans applies steps with 'toepas op'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Pas ... toe op' is the natural fixed expression and keeps the meaning.

toegepas.blok: Jou eie werk en jou omgewing
toegepas.voor: Kyk na plekke soos 'n winkelbord wat met die hand geverf is of lappe by 'n mark.
toegepas.na: Kyk na dinge soos lappe by 'n mark of 'n winkelbord wat met die hand geverf is.
toegepas.rede_vinder: A shop sign and cloths are not places, and with the sign first 'of lappe by 'n mark' can be misread as also painted by hand; the protected wording stays intact.
toegepas.fout: A shop sign and cloths are called 'plekke', a category slip, and the order lets 'met die hand geverf' seem to run into the cloths.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Same two examples, protected wording intact, and the sentence now reads cleanly.

laat_vaar.voor: Die nuwe derde soort is liggaamsversiering in Afrika.
laat_vaar.na: Die derde soort, liggaamsversiering in Afrika, is nuut.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Die nuwe derde soort' stacks two adjectives awkwardly; saying it is new at the end reads more naturally with the same word count.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The original reads acceptably; the appositive with two commas is a lateral move and slightly harder for a Grade 5 reader.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Rondom' is the natural word for the words surrounding another word; 'om hom' reads clipped.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Die woorde om hom' is natural Afrikaans (as in 'die mense om hom'); 'rondom' is a lateral swap.

na_skrywer.voor: Dieselfde woorde werk ook op die liggaam.
na_skrywer.na: Dieselfde woorde pas ook op die liggaam.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: Words that apply to something 'pas' on it; 'werk op' is a calque of English 'work on'.
na_skrywer.fout: 'Werk ook op die liggaam' calques English 'works on' in the sense of 'applies to'.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fault is real, but 'pas ook op die liggaam' can be read by a Grade 5 learner as 'look after the body', so the writer should find another fix.
